change_summary: Expose terminal live artifact readback and defer the detailed Work Model module so external Agents can continue with less redundant context.

canonical_skill.note: The compact entry Skill keeps consent, continuation and completion decisions stable while loading the full Work Model story only before structural organization.

server_contract.note: Terminal artifacts now say exactly which live identity, revision and hierarchy facts were re-resolved; the Host carries verified reader outputs without promoting its internal read trace.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together; compatibility family and minimum revision remain unchanged.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace and Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.35; their shared server-discovered processing-profile contract remains compatible and needs no CLI protocol change.

help_center.note: Public Help remains compatible because the public Skill page projects this shared package and the release does not change remote MCP connection or installation steps.

package_setup.note: SessionStart reports the new Skill release; the full Skill remains the authority while structural details move to an explicitly triggered reference module.

harness_and_mainline.note: The mainline records the difference between terminal identity readback, exact-body verification, user-facing output continuity and internal read traces.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party publication, public hashes and fresh released-host readback remain release gates; external directory acceptance stays outside repository authority.

release_evidence.note: Focused API, package and Host-handoff gates cover live readback truth, bounded reader-output continuation and on-demand Work Model loading; fresh selective Host cases remain the outcome gate.
